name: Ragnar Thunderbrew

narrative.details:
Ho, adventurer.  I heard that Ragnar Thunderbrew is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale.  He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.

Talk to Ragnar if you're interested.  He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText: You're right I'm mad!  I've been robbed!  Robbed of one of our family recipes!  How dare they!  As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves!  Now, oh... now they're in for it!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 55, 7,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
